description.value: Sooke Harbour House is a boutique oceanfront hotel and resort perched at the edge of the Strait of Juan de Fuca on Whiffin Spit Road in Sooke, BC. The property features individually designed rooms and suites with West Coast styling, an on-site restaurant, cafe, and wine cellar, and has recently undergone a change of ownership and revival under Catalog Hospitality. For touring cyclists approaching from the Galloping Goose Trail or the southern tip of Vancouver Island, it represents a notable endpoint or overnight destination with ocean-view rooms and on-site dining.
